description: Defines the Goteo\Application\View class responsible for managing template rendering, theme setting, and extension loading within the Goteo application, utilizing the Foil templating engine.

classes.name: Goteo\Application\View
classes.description: Manages template engine initialization, theme management, folder addition, extension loading, and rendering for the Goteo application using the Foil templating system.

methods.name: createEngine
methods.description: Initializes and configures the Foil engine with Goteo-specific extensions.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Initializes the Foil engine singleton if not already created.

methods.name: addFolder
methods.description: Adds a folder to the template search paths.

methods.name: prependFolder
methods.description: Adds a folder at the beginning of the search paths.

methods.name: loadExtension
methods.description: Loads an extension into the Foil engine.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders a template view with variables and optional event firing.

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets the current theme, searching for theme directories and updating search paths.
